earlier_scan.source_named: Glottolog refs are wordlists/overviews only (Persson 1997; Evans-Pritchard 1937); no grammar or phonology exists.

sources.citation: Persson, Janet. 2004. Bongo-Bagirmi languages in Sudan. Occasional Papers in the Study of Sudanese Languages 9: 77-84. Entebbe: SIL-Sudan.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress for any language; Mo'da/Gberi not named (chain described as Baka - Morokodo - Jur Modo - Nyamusa - 'Beli; refers to Persson 1997 OPSL 7 for the comparative survey). Consonant/vowel/orthography charts for Baka, Morokodo, Jur Modo, Bongo only.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid page moda1242 (reference list) and archive.org-wide full-text probes 'Gberi'+stress, 'Gberi'+'Morokodo' (hits: Baxter & Butt 1953 ethnographic survey, Greenberg Languages of Africa classification list, Mann & Dalby Thesaurus, Wikipedia print-outs).
sources.note: No description of Mo'da anywhere; Glottolog has 0 descriptive refs (Vinson 1911 'langues Kol ou Munda' is a mis-attached Munda item).

sources.citation: Tucker, A. N. 1934. Survey of the language groups in the Southern Sudan. Bulletin of the School of Oriental Studies 7(4).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing; footnote only: 'Seligman mentions another tribe, Gberi, living west of Mvolo, and speaking a dialect akin to Mittu (Pagan Tribes of the Nilotic Sudan, p. 474). I was unable to locate this tribe.'

sources.citation: Persson, Andrew M. 1997. Grouping of the Bongo-Baka languages. Occasional Papers in the Study of Sudanese Languages 7: 19-39. Nairobi: SIL-Sudan.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: The only linguistic publication that includes Mo'da data (comparative survey of the Baka-Morokodo-Modo-Nyamusa-Beli chain with wordlists); if any phonological notes on Mo'da (tone/stress marking conventions) exist in print, they are here.

sources.citation: SIL South Sudan unpublished survey materials / wordlists for Mo'da [gbn] (none listed in the SIL OLAC feed as of 2026-09-17; Persson's 1990s Bongo-Baka survey data underlying OPSL 7).
